releases.notes:
## MateSignal v1.0.0

Supports **all Minecraft versions from 1.14.4 through 26.2**.

### Requirements
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

### Installation
1. Download the jar for your Minecraft version
2. Place it in your \.minecraft/mods\ folder
3. (Optional) Install [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for a config screen

### Downloads
Download the jar matching your Minecraft version below.
